newsitem.title: NORWAY: Amerada extends Transocean rig contract.
newsitem.headline: Amerada extends Transocean rig contract.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said on Thursday Amerada Hess Corp had confirmed the extension of a long-term charter of the semisubmersible Transocean 8 rig with Norwegian subsidiary Transocean ASA.
The five-month extension was valued at around $17 million and eliminated an open interval in the rig's schedule, Transocean said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
The rig was expected to operate in the U.K. sector of the North Sea during the period.
Amerada Hess had previously agreed to contract Transocean 8 for a firm period of two years beginning May 1, 1997, with a three-year option to follow.
As part of that agreement the rig will undergo an upgrade to increase its water-depth rating. Estimated cost of the upgrade was $47.5 million.
